title: Uncensored Is Not Unbiased: Abliteration Removes Refusals but Not Script-Dependent Bias About Taiwan

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating yes/no probabilities on matched statement pairs representing opposing political views (ROC vs. PRC) regarding Taiwan's sovereignty and the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests, calculating an alignment score (Index S), and analyzing free-text responses for political framing and refusals.

Comparing model responses and political alignment scores across identical prompts translated into Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese (via character-level conversion), and English to measure script-dependent shifts in political stance.
